MASTERMIND · COMPANY INTELLIGENCE · D07
Read me & Build contract
Phase 2A · 3 November 2026 · Source/specification continuation · Reference acceptance open

The analyst’s job
Form and challenge a company thesis after a report. Identify what changed, which expectation is comparable and which evidence could invalidate the view. Keep Company, Earnings and Expectations connected by exact listing, period and source identity.

Complete task flow
Company brief → reported result + prior guidance or analyst estimate → same-period comparison → source receipt → invalidation evidence → deliberate watch → return. Calendar entry retains the selected event, date, filters, row focus and scroll. Reading or changing context is a local action.

Route and object ownership
/analysis uses terminal/lib/analysisRoute.ts for Company, Your theses and Saved investigations. Keep page/pane compatibility and ci_* historical identity. Macro owns /stock.html#symbol, /stocks/<id>.html, /capital_structure.html and /financial_lineage.html. Expectation explorer uses ?t=AAPL#es-explorer. Generated articles keep their exact slugs and anchors.

Comparisons and clocks
Keep quarter, fiscal year, half-year and YTD distinct even when period-end dates match. A usable delta needs matched listing/issuer scope, metric, currency, unit, basis, period and allowed source vintage. Show filing publication, producer collection, estimate acquisition and page-build clocks separately. A missing benchmark stays unavailable. Zero stays zero.

Evidence, access and saves
Historical evidence keeps its receipt and revision. A tx-only transcript bookmark reopens a call and needs requalification for an exact passage. Private content follows the current account and rights epoch. Public earnings v2 reads coverage_states; formatted reported/guidance values are display text. Watch requires explicit action and owner/list/symbol readback after an uncertain response.

Responsive acceptance
320px gives 288px of content and 390px gives 358px under both foundation candidates. Show identity → period → metric/comparator → result → evidence. Keep important controls at least 44px high. At 1280px, the candidate expanded rail + docked inspector leaves 664px for the primary task. Qualify that density with full labels, tabular values, keyboard focus, EN/ZH, light/dark and reflow.

Retained Paper references
Company R3 · p-S-0 keeps brief 1BEK-0 and Expectations 1CD3-0. Its 390px frame 1D9K-0 is the known empty successor. R2 p-M-1 supplies Chinese/320 patterns and p-L-1 supplies lineage states. Expectation Surface R1 · p-1-0 supplies the descriptive family. Final composition follows verified F01/F02 v1.

Foundation and review state
F01-F02-SHELL/1.0.0-candidate.1 at b2d00ddc · F02-SYSTEM/1.0.0-candidate.2 at c6eb32e1. F02 concurrence at f7c25c4b still needs F01 resolution. Gutter cutoffs and overlay widths differ. Delivery PARTIAL across the full assignment. D07 reference RIG remains draft / unsubmitted. The in-Paper contract records completed research and open dependencies.

Build from the source return
D07 owns product composition. Filing, estimates, Earnings OS, Terminal, Macro and save owners retain data and write authority. Read EXPERIENCE, ANALYSIS, MACRO, EARNINGS, RESPONSIVE, RETENTION and ACCEPTANCE in the D07 source package on Draft #10617. Source baseline d8ff43f6 · assignment 6e186286 · procedure b2326bbe. Diagnostic reproductions establish current source behavior. Review requires an immutable candidate export set and independent product/taste findings.
